Townsfolk.name: Washerwoman
Townsfolk.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the character token of a Townsfolk in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

Townsfolk.name: Librarian
Townsfolk.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the character token of an Outsider in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

Townsfolk.name: Investigator
Townsfolk.description: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the character token of a Minion in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

Townsfolk.name: Chef
Townsfolk.description: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2, …) for the number of pairs of neighbouring evil players.

Townsfolk.name: Empath
Townsfolk.description: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbours are evil.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil alive neighbours of the Empath.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil neighbours.

Townsfolk.name: Fortune Teller
Townsfolk.description: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Fortune Teller points to two players. Give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether one of those players is the Demon.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Fortune Teller points to two players. Show the head signal (nod 'yes', shake 'no') for whether one of those players is the Demon.

Townsfolk.name: Undertaker
Townsfolk.description: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today: Show that player's character token.

Townsfolk.name: Monk
Townsfolk.description: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The previously protected player is no longer protected. The Monk points to a player not themself. Mark that player 'Protected'.

Townsfolk.name: Ravenkeeper
Townsfolk.description: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight: The Ravenkeeper points to a player. Show that player's character token.

Townsfolk.name: Virgin
Townsfolk.description: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.

Townsfolk.name: Slayer
Townsfolk.description: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

Townsfolk.name: Soldier
Townsfolk.description: You are safe from the Demon.

Townsfolk.name: Mayor
Townsfolk.description: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

Outsiders.name: Butler
Outsiders.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
Outsiders.firstNightReminder: The Butler points to a player. Mark that player as 'Master'.
Outsiders.otherNightReminder: The Butler points to a player. Mark that player as 'Master'.

Outsiders.name: Drunk
Outsiders.description: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

Outsiders.name: Recluse
Outsiders.description: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.

Outsiders.name: Saint
Outsiders.description: If you die by execution, your team loses.

Minions.name: Poisoner
Minions.description: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
Minions.firstNightReminder: The Poisoner points to a player. That player is poisoned.
Minions.otherNightReminder: The previously poisoned player is no longer poisoned. The Poisoner points to a player. That player is poisoned.

Minions.name: Spy
Minions.description: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
Minions.firstNightReminder: Show the Grimoire to the Spy for as long as they need.
Minions.otherNightReminder: Show the Grimoire to the Spy for as long as they need.

Minions.name: Scarlet Woman
Minions.description: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count)
Minions.otherNightReminder: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today: Show the 'You are' card, then the demon token.

Minions.name: Baron
Minions.description: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

Demons.name: Imp
Demons.description: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
Demons.otherNightReminder: The Imp points to a player. That player dies. If the Imp chose themselves: Replace the character of 1 alive minion with a spare Imp token. Show the 'You are' card, then the Imp token.

Travellers.name: Bureaucrat
Travellers.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
Travellers.firstNightReminder: The Bureaucrat points to a player. Put the Bureaucrat's '3 votes' reminder by the chosen player's character token.
Travellers.otherNightReminder: The Bureaucrat points to a player. Put the Bureaucrat's '3 votes' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

Travellers.name: Thief
Travellers.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
Travellers.firstNightReminder: The Thief points to a player. Put the Thief's 'Negative vote' reminder by the chosen player's character token.
Travellers.otherNightReminder: The Thief points to a player. Put the Thief's 'Negative vote' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

Travellers.name: Gunslinger
Travellers.description: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.

Travellers.name: Scapegoat
Travellers.description: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.

Travellers.name: Beggar
Travellers.description: You must use a vote token to vote. Dead players may choose to give you theirs. If so, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
